meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: 安装后，当你要求定制记忆方式时，Claude 会引导你定义想记什么、跳过什么，据此创建并安装一个新的 claude-mem“模式”（含观察类型和概念标签），可选设置 Telegram 提醒，重启服务并验证模式已生效。
howto.when: 当你说要定制 claude-mem 记住什么、创建或修改模式、为某类记忆发 Telegram 通知等时触发——即使你没说“模式”两字。

say.text: 帮我建一个模式，记录法律案例的规则和考试陷阱。
say.note: Claude 会先问你几个问题，然后生成并安装模式。

say.text: 现在用的模式不适合我的项目，我想改一下观察类型。
say.note: 它会让你调整分类，并在批准后重新安装。

say.text: 当记录到“合同条款”这类标签时，给我发 Telegram 通知。
say.note: 需要你提供机器人令牌和聊天 ID，并先测试。

howto.what_en: After install, on request, Claude guides you to define what to remember and skip, then creates and installs a new claude-mem mode (observation types + concept tags), optionally configures Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies activation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change modes, or get Telegram notifications for certain memories—even without the word "mode".

say_en.text: Create a mode that records legal case rules and exam traps.
say_en.note: Claude asks questions, then creates and installs it.

say_en.text: The current mode doesn't fit; I want to change the observation types.
say_en.note: It lets you adjust categories and reinstalls after approval.

say_en.text: Notify me on Telegram when a note gets tagged "contract clause".
say_en.note: Requires your bot token and chat ID, and sends a test first.
